function.name: query_vessel_telemetry
function.description: Query real-time or historical IoT telemetry data from offshore vessels. Returns engine load, hull stress, and fuel metrics.

vessel_id.description: The unique identifier of the vessel (e.g., 'VSL-004').

metric.description: The specific metric to query, or 'all' for full telemetry.

time_range_hours.description: Number of hours to look back for historical data. Default is 24.

function.name: execute_halal_cross_reference
function.description: Cross-reference a Halal certificate number against the official JAKIM/Global Halal blockchain ledger to verify authenticity and check for recalls.

function.name: adjust_ras_environmental_controls
function.description: Send direct commands to the Recirculating Aquaculture System (RAS) IoT controllers to adjust aerators, feeders, or water exchange valves.

tank_id.description: The ID of the RAS tank (e.g., 'RAS-09').

aerator_speed_percent.description: Speed of the aerator in percentage.

stop_feeding.description: Set to true to immediately halt automated feeding.

emergency_water_exchange_percent.description: Percentage of water to exchange immediately (Max 50% to prevent shock).
